news.title: OpenAI announces enterprise agent toolkit for workflow automation
news.summary: OpenAI released a new AI agent toolkit focused on enterprise workflow automation and secure deployment, with API integrations for major cloud platforms.

news.title: Google DeepMind publishes new multimodal model benchmark
news.summary: The research benchmark compares multimodal model performance across reasoning, code, and long-context tasks, showing measurable improvements.

news.title: 欧盟更新人工智能监管框架，强化高风险模型合规
news.summary: 欧盟发布最新AI政策草案，要求高风险大模型在数据治理、安全测试和透明度方面提高合规标准。

news.title: NVIDIA unveils next-gen inference chip targeting lower AI cost
news.summary: NVIDIA announced an inference-focused chip designed to reduce serving cost and improve throughput for large language model deployment.

news.title: 国内头部云厂商发布大模型应用平台，主打企业提效
news.summary: 新平台提供AI工作流编排、知识库检索与智能体管理，面向金融、零售和制造行业落地场景。

news.title: Anthropic reports improved safety alignment in latest LLM release
news.summary: Anthropic shared safety evaluation results indicating reduced harmful outputs and better refusal behavior in sensitive prompts.

news.title: AI startup raises Series B to build healthcare copilots
news.summary: A healthcare AI startup secured new funding to expand clinical documentation copilots and hospital workflow automation.

news.title: 研究团队在arXiv发布高效推理论文，降低模型延迟
news.summary: 新论文提出推理优化方法，在保持准确率的同时显著降低延迟和GPU占用，适用于大模型在线服务。

news.title: Major bank expands AI coding assistant to 20,000 developers
news.summary: The bank scaled internal AI coding tools to thousands of engineers, citing productivity gains and faster release cycles.

news.title: 监管机构调查生成式AI数据使用争议
news.summary: 多国监管机构关注生成式AI训练数据来源与版权边界，相关企业面临更高合规审查压力。

news.title: 微软发布面向开发者的Agent SDK更新
news.summary: Microsoft updated its developer Agent SDK with observability and tool-calling improvements for production AI systems.

news.title: 高校与产业联合启动人工智能人才培养计划
news.summary: 该计划将围绕大模型工程化、AI安全与行业应用课程展开，预计覆盖数万名学生与工程师。
